content_sections.heading: About CUSB
content_sections.text: Central University of South Bihar is located at SH-7, Gaya-Panchanpur Road, P.O.: Fatehpur, District-Gaya (Bihar), Pin-824236. This post sits in the Department of Agriculture under its School of Agriculture & Development. The project is titled "Development of a rapid assay for detection of Fusarium graminearum for mitigation of diseases in millets."

content_sections.heading: CUSB Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026

rows.pay: Rs. 37,000/- per Month + HRA (subject to final document verification)

content_sections.heading: CUSB Junior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 28 Years. Age relaxation is admissible as per ANRF guidelines. Essential qualification: Master of Science (Agriculture) in (Genetics & Plant Breeding/ Plant Breeding & Genetics/ Genetics). Qualification and experience should be from a recognized institute. Desirable: Highly motivated candidates with good knowledge of: Genetics, Biotechnology and Plant breeding Plant pathology Bio-analytical techniques Data analysis and their interpretations See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

rows.event: Last date to submit the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of an interview, and the mode of interview is Offline/Online. Fulfilling the essential qualification alone does not guarantee an interview call or selection.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is temporary, initially for 01 year, and extendable up to the next 02 years or co-terminus with the project. The post will be on a contractual basis for the duration of the project, which runs for 3 years. The appointment can be terminated with one month notice or one month salary from either side without assigning any reason. The selected candidate will work on this project and on any other work the Principal Investigator assigns from time to time. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview or for joining the post. Candidates should make their own arrangements for the duration of the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUSB Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents to send: Bio-data/C.V. 250 words write up Statement of marks Experience All testimonials

faq.question: Q1. Which degree is required for the CUSB Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Master of Science (Agriculture) in Genetics & Plant Breeding, Plant Breeding & Genetics, or Genetics.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply by email?
faq.answer: Yes. Send your application as an attachment to [email protected], or post it to the Principal Investigator in Gaya.

faq.question: Q3. What should the application include?
faq.answer: It should include your bio-data/C.V., a 250 words write up, statement of marks, experience and all testimonials.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It is initially for 01 year and can be extended up to the next 02 years, or it may be co-terminus with the 3-year project.

faq.question: Q5. Is the interview held in person?
faq.answer: The notice gives the mode of interview as Offline/Online.

faq.question: Q6. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA is not paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

faq.question: Q7. Can the appointment be ended early?
faq.answer: Yes. Either side can end it with one month notice or one month salary, without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q8. Whom can students contact about this post?
faq.answer: Students may write to Dr. Pranav Tripathi, the Principal Investigator and Assistant Professor, at the email address given in the notice.
